hero.sub: Tropical South Indian flavors with a Berlin heartbeat. Authentic Kerala dishes, house brews and a warm, loud, happy crowd — welcome to kokoland.

about.body: Porotta with beef fry, kappa biryani, puttu with kadala curry, and the Indo-Chinese street food Kerala loves: Gobi Manchurian, Chilli Paneer. We cook Kerala's favourites the way they are meant to taste and serve them in a warm, loud, happy room in Berlin.

menu.title: A rotating menu.
menu.story: Our menu rotates: new dishes land on the board and old favourites make room. Kerala is a coast of many kitchens, from Malabar in the north to Travancore in the south, and we cook our way through all of them.
menu.live: {{count}} dishes on the menu right now

catering.body: Bring the authentic taste of Kerala to your next event. From intimate gatherings to grand celebrations — we cater Kerala vibes that stay in memory.
catering.service1_d: A Kerala feast for birthdays, from small tables to big crowds.
catering.service2_d: Team building with Kerala street-food experiences.
catering.service3_d: Custom menus for weddings and celebrations.

reservation.sub: Come hungry. Pick a day and time and we'll save you a seat for Kerala food and good company.
reservation.form_sub: Tell us when you're coming and we'll take it from there. Booking for more than 10? Send us a message.

footer.tagline: Kerala flavors, Berlin home. Tropical South Indian cooking served warm and loud since 2021.

kollective.teaser_body: Arts, culture and music nights — with food at the heart. kokoland Kollective brings Kerala's creative spirit to Berlin's stages, walls and turntables.
kollective.hero_sub: A collective of cooks, musicians and makers. We throw gigs, exhibitions, supper clubs and workshops where Kerala's culture meets Berlin's underground — always around a shared table.
kollective.w1_d: Toddy-shop sessions, DJ nights and live bands — South Indian rhythms meets Berlin bass.
kollective.w2_d: Exhibitions, film nights and pop-ups with Kerala artists and the city's creative crowd.
kollective.w3_d: Long-table feasts on banana leaf — twelve courses, one loud, happy room.
kollective.w4_d: Cooking, spice and craft workshops — learn the stories behind the flavors.
kollective.ev1_desc: Live music, house arrack sours & Kerala small plates till late.
kollective.ev2_desc: A twelve-course banana-leaf feast at one long communal table.
kollective.ev3_desc: Pop-up exhibition of Kerala art, photography and sound.
kollective.follow_body: Every gig, exhibition and supper lands on Instagram first. Follow along — or bring your event to our table.

cookies.title: We use cookies
cookies.body: We use necessary cookies to run kokoland (cart, login, language). With your consent we'd also like to use analytics cookies to understand how the site is used. You can change this anytime in Cookie Settings.
cookies.necessary_desc: Required for the site to work — cart, login session, language and cookie preference. Always on.
cookies.analytics_desc: Helps us understand which pages and dishes are popular so we can improve the site.
cookies.marketing_desc: Lets us measure the effect of promotions and offers. Not used yet, off by default.
